name: Corner Lane Coffee morning pickup
reader: Office workers rushing to catch the metro in the morning
facts: Pickup available on weekdays from 07:30 to 10:00
After ordering on your phone, you can book a pickup slot within the next 15 minutes
In the shop, collect your cup from the shelf labeled with your booked slot
The shop is a 3-minute walk from the metro exit
¥2 off if you bring your own cup
action: Choose morning pickup in the shop's mini-program

name: Weekend bike check-up stand
reader: People whose bike sat unused all winter and who are getting ready to commute by bike again
facts: Covers tire pressure, brakes, chain and lights
If a part needs replacing, you get a quote first and it is replaced only with the owner's consent
Parts are not included in the price
Slots can be booked on the hour or half hour
action: Book a check-up slot on the shop's page

name: Clay Dots beginner pottery class
reader: Adults who want to try making things by hand but have no experience
facts: Every Sunday afternoon starting at 14:00, 90 minutes per class
Includes materials, tools and one firing
Pieces are ready to collect about two weeks after firing
The studio provides aprons; wear clothes that are easy to move in
action: Reply "beginner class" to the studio's official account to see available spots
